rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice, especially for a supermarket.

example.english: I go to the grocery store to buy ingredients after work.
example.jyutping: ngo5 fong3 gung1 hau6 heoi3 ciu1 si5 maai5 sung3

rows.note: Use this for a small local shop selling snacks, drinks, and basic groceries rather than a large supermarket.

example.english: Ming went to the grocery store downstairs to buy a bottle of soda.
example.traditional: 阿明落去樓下間士多買枝汽水。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 lok6 heoi3 lau4 haa6 gaan1 si6 do1 maai5 zi1 hei3 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize a traditional shop selling assorted household groceries.

example.english: This old-fashioned grocery store sells all sorts of things.
example.traditional: 呢間老字號雜貨舖乜都有得賣。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 lou5 zi6 hou6 zaap6 fo3 pou2 mat1 dou1 jau5 dak1 maai6
